description: Sun Ce, young fiery chinese warlord in the supplied pixel art style. Spiky brown hair with a red plumed headband, red and black armor with gold trim, a long red cape, dark boots. He holds a short halberd upright in the right hand and a second short blade low in the left hand
face: Bold confident young eyes, no beard.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: spiky brown hair with the red plume, the long red cape covering the back, the halberd at his right side.
guard_action: both hands lift their weapons up in front of the body, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Twin-weapon fighting guard, one weapon in each hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with a weapon in each hand, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: Right-hand cut with the left weapon held as a guard. Frames 1-5 the right weapon is raised; frame 8 it cuts down diagonally while the left weapon stays up in front; frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b1: Two cuts, right then left. Frames 1-5 wind up; frame 7 the right weapon cuts; frame 9 the left weapon cuts; frames 10-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a2: Rising right-hand cut, left weapon blocking low. Frames 1-5 the right weapon drops low; frame 8 it cuts upward while the left weapon guards low; frames 9-11 finish high. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s3: Conqueror surge. Frames 1-6 he winds back with both weapons to one side; frame 8 both weapons sweep around level in one wide arc; frames 9-12 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The twin short halberds stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: Leaping double downward cut. Frames 1-4 crouch; frames 5-7 both feet leave the ground with both weapons raised; frame 8 he lands cutting down with both; frames 9-11 absorb the landing.
actions.c6: Spinning double cut. The body winds, makes one full turn on the spot with both weapons held out, and both blades come round onto the target; a short hold.
actions.b2: Two quick thrusts, one with each weapon. The right weapon is thrust straight forward, then the left one; a short hold with both weapons forward.
actions.a3: Crossing cut with both weapons. Frames 1-5 both arms open wide; frame 8 both weapons cut inward and cross in front of the body; frames 9-11 hold crossed.
actions.c4: Rising double cut from a low hidden guard. Both weapons are held low behind the body, the knees bend, and they are cut upward through the target one after the other as the body rises; they finish high.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 a1 → b1 → a2, 전법 s3. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
